coordinateFrame.note: Patient exterior is a stylized presentation of BP3D FMA:7163 skin in the canonical frame (warm clinical materials). No global exterior conformer is required when this mesh is the visible exterior.

canonicalBridge.note: When exterior is already BP3D-derived, conformer is effectively identity; flag still loads hidden canonical for clinician tooling.
